Maria: opened PR to sync SDK snippets across py/ts/go for streaming, retries, pagination. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4132 — please scan for API name changes and runtime expectations.
Ryan: noted. TS snippet still uses `cursor` param; runtime uses `page_token`. I'll push a patch renaming it and add a note that `page_size` is advisory.
Tom: i'll validate the python streaming examples locally. the current sync snippet didn't use a context manager which can hang in some setups. will propose both sync and async variants.
Laura: for async python include `async with` + `async for`. also mention `max_retries` and jittered backoff example. folks often forget to set read timeouts and hang on partial frames.
Tom: quick sync snippet i ran (works with small batches):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.stream_response(model="redwood-stream-1") as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text)
```
Ryan: pushed TS change (cursor -> page_token) and added `max_retries: 3` plus comment about exponential jitter. commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ba9c3f1
Laura: async python snippet to add:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async def main():
    client = AsyncClient()
    async with client.stream_response(model="redwood-stream-1") as stream:
        async for chunk in stream:
            print(chunk.text)
```
Maria: add a brief note about prefix buffering when streaming partial JSON; recommend using `structured_output` and validating intermittently.
Ryan: updated the docs to call out prefix buffering and linked to the stability note. also adjusted TS to show `await stream.read()` pattern for chunked JSON.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR 4132 (lint + smoke tests). https://ci.internal/redwood/4132/45
Tom: tested Go snippet: client returns frames channel, updated example to range over `resp.Chan` in docs.
Maria: all checks green. merging after minor formatting nitfix (line length). thanks everyone :slightly_smiling_face:
